map.本工具用于检测（超声/磁粉/水压）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates the weld inspection service (UT / MT / Hydrostatic). It checks the input data against the corresponding format and syntax specifications in real time and pinpoints errors. Runs entirely in the browser; no data is uploaded.
map.📚 深度解析：焊缝三项检测判定（超声/磁粉/水压）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Weld Acceptance (UT / MT / Hydrostatic)
map.焊接质量自检：按超声检测灵敏度、磁粉检测等级、水压试验三项判定: Self-check of weld quality: judge by UT sensitivity, MT grade, and hydrostatic test pressure.
map.缺陷排查：超声与磁粉查内部/表面缺陷: Defect screening: UT and MT locate internal / surface defects.
map.逐项判定：超声检测灵敏度≤2Φmm、磁粉检测等级≤2 级、水压试验压力≥1.5: Item-by-item check: UT sensitivity ≤ 2Φmm, MT grade ≤ 2, hydrostatic pressure ≥ 1.5×; all three must be met for acceptance. Excess sensitivity/grade flags defects; insufficient hydrostatic pressure fails leak detection.
map.超声灵敏度 1.5Φmm（≤2 ✓）、磁粉等级 2 级（≤2 ✓）、水压 1.6: UT sensitivity 1.5Φmm (≤2 ✓), MT grade 2 (≤2 ✓), hydrostatic 1.6× (≥1.5 ✓): all three pass → accepted. If UT sensitivity rises to 3Φmm, it fails and defect-detection capability is degraded.
map.为可检出的最小平底孔当量（Φ2mm），数值越小灵敏度越高；≤2Φmm 为示例严值: It is the smallest equivalent flat-bottom hole detectable (Φ2mm); the smaller the value, the higher the sensitivity. ≤2Φmm is an example strict limit, set by the acceptance level (e.g. GB/T 11345).
map.水压 1.5 倍怎么来？: Where does the 1.5× hydrostatic factor come from?
map.为常用水压试验压力系数（设计压力×1.5），保压查泄漏与强度；具体倍率与保压时间: It is the common hydrostatic test pressure coefficient (design pressure ×1.5), held to check leakage and strength; the exact factor and hold time follow the code and the medium.
map.超声检测需标定试块和探头参数: UT inspection requires calibrated reference blocks and probe parameters.
map.磁粉检测需控制磁化电流和磁悬液浓度: MT inspection requires control of magnetization current and suspension concentration.
map.关于「检测（超声/磁粉/水压）服务」: About the Weld Inspection (UT / MT / Hydrostatic) Service
map.焊缝超声检测、磁粉检测、水压试验三项检测工具，依据GB/T 11345、GB/T: A three-item inspection tool for weld UT, MT, and hydrostatic test, judging pass/fail against standards such as GB/T 11345, GB/T 15822, and GB/T 13927. Suitable for non-destructive testing and pressure acceptance of welded parts.
map.支持超声检测灵敏度、磁粉检测等级、水压试验压力等多项指标检测: Supports multiple indicators including UT sensitivity, MT grade, and hydrostatic test pressure.
